description.value: Pre-Cinder wards weren't built to stop looters, but you've learned to read them anyway. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Disable a Device or overcome a ward that carries the arcane trait, and on a critical failure you suffer no additional ill effect beyond a normal failure.

cinderfall.incomplete: No skill is confirmed for 'checks to Disable a Device or overcome a ward' (Disable a Device is normally Thievery, but 'overcome a ward' is undefined), and there is no established hazard/ward actor in this corpus carrying an 'arcane' trait for a target:trait predicate to read; the critical-failure protection also has no hook.
